rationale: C03 supplies an almost verbatim operative sentence: the same first-person designation of “such organization” as a public international organization entitled to the same privileges, exemptions, and immunities under the same Act. C08 and C17 use the same designation formula but require changes in the referent or number. This is concrete, material drafting overlap rather than merely a shared topic or statutory duty.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate such organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate such organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said Act.
shared_material.explanation: The operative clause is essentially identical in wording, syntax, legal effect, and statutory reference, with only punctuation and the fuller naming of the Act differing.
